book.name: 1 Amǝ Tasalonika
book.title: Cauterǝa mǝdǝmbe mala Bulǝs aban ká a ban AMƏ TASALONIKA

content: Mǝnia yì cauterǝa ka pur nǝban Bulǝs, andǝ Silas, andǝ Timoti. Aban ká a ban ikǝlisiya mala amǝ Tasalonika, aɓwana mala Ɓakuli Tárrú, andǝa mala Mǝtalabangŋo Yesu Kǝrǝsti.
Ɓǝ̀ ɓwamuru andǝ dorǝpwala mala Ɓakuli do atà wun.
Paɓamuru mala amǝkpataYesu a Tasalonika ka
A koya pwari ka, sǝm nggǝ pakki Ɓakuli yàwá ace wun, sǝ sǝm nggǝ pak hiwi tùtù ace wun kat.

Aɓa hiwi ma'sǝm amur wun a ban Ɓakuli ma'sǝm yì Tarrú ka, sǝm nggǝ ɗenyi nǝ pé ma'wun aɓa paɓamuru, andǝ earcearǝu ma'wun mǝnana tsǝa wu pak túró kǝ̀rkǝ́r, andǝ came mala tsǝkɓalǝu ma'wun arǝ Mǝtala sǝm Yesu Kǝrǝsti.
Wun amǝ'eam sǝm, sǝm sǝlǝna ama Ɓakuli earǝna ce wun, nda sǝ tàr wun ace mǝnana ɓǝ̀ wu duk aɓwana male ka.

Cau Amsǝban mǝnana sǝm yiu nǝi a ban wun ngga, pà aɓa ne anggo nǝmurǝì ɗàng, nda gbal aɓa rǝcandǝa mala Bangŋo Mǝfele, andǝ pa'eare mǝkǝ̀rkǝr nì mǝnana lǝmdǝ ama cau mana sǝm na ka mǝsǝcau na ka. Wu sǝlǝna rǝ ulang do mǝnana sǝm do aɓalǝ wun àkǝ̀ ce ɓoaro ma'wun ngga.
Wu yi duk amǝ twalkusǝ sǝm andǝ mala Mǝtalabangŋo; kat andǝ tanni ma'wun kǝ̀rkǝ́r ka, wu ak cau mala Ɓakuli nǝ banɓoarnado mala Bangŋo Mǝfele.
Ace mǝno ka, wu dumǝna amǝkpata Yesu mǝnana amǝkwaɗi aɓa nzali Masǝdoniya andǝ Akaya kat, à nǝ̀ sǝni arǝ wun sǝ à nǝ̀ twal kusǝ wun ngga.

Sǝ ado, cau mala Mǝtalabangŋo ka, nda rǝ puro nǝ ban wun aban ká a ban aɓwana aɓa nzali Masǝdoniya andǝ Akaya kat. Sǝa ma mǝno nda nǝmurǝì ɗàng, cau mala paɓamuru ma'wun gbal a ban Ɓakuli ka, mesǝna a ban aɓwana a koya ban. Yàle sǝm pànǝ cau mǝnana ɗǝm sǝm nǝ̀ nea wia amur paɓamuru ma'wun ngga ɗàng.
Aɓwana nǝ ɓamuria nda à cama rǝ nacau mala agir mǝɓoarne mǝnana wu pak kat ace ak sǝm, mana sǝm waria sǝn wun ngga. À bang ce vwakibu ma'wun arǝ ankúl ace kpata Ɓakuli mǝ'mǝsǝcau nì andǝ mǝyilǝmuì.

Ɗǝm ngga à bang cau mala do kundǝmuru ma'wun arǝ yiu mala Muna mala Ɓakuli nǝ kuli, yì muna male mana loasǝi a ɓembe ka. Nda Yesu mana nda mǝ'amsǝ sǝm a bu tanni mala bumlulla mǝɓike mala Ɓakuli mǝnana kǝ yiu ka.
